services.title: Interior Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Complete interior refresh including feature walls, ceiling work, and timber finishes. We move furniture, protect floors, and leave your home spotless.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Weather Protection
services.desc: Exterior walls, doors, windows, and fascias. Fully prepared surfaces and weather-resistant finishes that withstand Leeds winters.

services.title: Fine Finish Spray Painting
services.desc: Professional spray finishes for furniture, doors, cabinets, and bespoke joinery. Smooth, durable results without brush marks or runs.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Hanging, stripping, and pattern matching. From traditional papers to modern textures and statement designs.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Maintenance
services.desc: Office repaints, retail spaces, and ongoing commercial maintenance. Flexible scheduling to minimise business disruption.

services.title: Preparation & Surface Repairs
services.desc: Full wall preparation, crack repair, plastering, and sanding. Quality prep is the foundation of every perfect finish.

about_pullquote: A good decorator transforms a house into a home. That's what we do every single day.
about_para_1: DM Decorating was founded on the simple principle that decoration should be both beautiful and honest. Over 15 years, we've earned a loyal following across Leeds by turning up on time, doing the job right, and leaving your home exactly as we found it—except better. We've completed over 800 projects, from Victorian terraces to modern apartments, and we treat every room like it matters.
about_para_2: Our specialist spray-finishing service sets us apart. Whether you're updating kitchen doors, refinishing furniture, or creating a bespoke interior, our fine finish spraying delivers a quality that brush and roller simply can't match. We're fully insured, use quality materials throughout, and guarantee our work. Most importantly, we listen—your vision is our priority.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Had DM Decorating in to repaint our lounge and hallway. David was punctual, tidy, and really took pride in his work. Two coats, proper prep, no mess. Finished ahead of schedule and the finish is flawless. Highly recommend—will definitely have him back for the kitchen.
reviews.author: Marcus T.

reviews.text: Asked for a spray finish on some new kitchen doors and the results are stunning. Absolutely smooth, professional quality. Not cheap, but you get what you pay for. Made a real difference to the space without the expense of new units.
reviews.author: Claire W.

reviews.text: Brilliant service from start to finish. Free quote was honest, work began on time, and he kept the disruption to a minimum. My Victorian terrace looks completely refreshed. Professional, friendly, and fair pricing. Can't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: Robert K.
